input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Older powerful man, deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms and leather pouches, heavy gnarled staff with angular stone head. Floating stone motes and compact dust. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of this same figure collapsing. Row 1: 1 upright ready; 2 knees/legs buckle, torso drops; 3 body low and leaning to the ground. Row 2: 4 torso falls forward or sideways, nearly horizontal; 5 entire torso and head touch ground; 6 completely still fully LYING ON GROUND with equipment resting beside the body. Last pose must be fully lying, never sitting, crouching or kneeling. A harmless theatrical fall/rest, intact body, no blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. Each complete pose occupies ONLY HALF its spacious cell. Entire feet, staff and all equipment stay far from the image boundary. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Show BACK OF HEAD AND BACK OF SHOULDER WRAP in every pose. Final prone body points head toward UPPER RIGHT and feet toward LOWER LEFT, face DOWN hidden against ground, back uppermost. NO visible eyes or face in final two poses. Last body completely flat, not kneeling. Make all six figures SMALL inside their cells with at least 15 percent clear magenta on every side. First four poses should progressively lower torso, no repeated standing pose. Staff lies diagonally parallel to prone body.

arguments.Prompt: Original painted game character animation sheet on uniform vivid solid magenta background (#FF00FF). Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows grid layout showing 6 sequential poses of the same character collapsing, viewed from elevated 55-degree orthographic angle, rear-right three-quarter view (head and torso facing diagonally away from viewer and toward image right, back surfaces clearly visible). Character Identity based on reference-1: Older powerful man with deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, wearing a broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth robes, stone charms and leather pouches, holding a heavy gnarled staff with an angular geometric stone head. Small floating stone motes and compact dust around him. Painting style based on reference-2: Hand-painted digital dark fantasy concept art, sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth, smooth opaque paint, no heavy cartoon outlines, no 3D render. Camera & Perspective: Elevated 55-degree orthographic view. Throughout the collapse, the camera strictly sees the back surfaces of the character (back of head, back of hooded shoulder wrap, back of robes). He falls forward diagonally away from the camera, never rolling onto his back, never turning to face the camera. 6 Sequential Poses across 3 columns and 2 rows: Row 1, Cell 1: Upright ready stance, rear-right three-quarter view, back visible, holding gnarled stone staff. Row 1, Cell 2: Knees buckling, legs giving way, torso beginning to drop downwards. Row 1, Cell 3: Body low, knees bent deep, leaning forward toward the ground. Row 2, Cell 4: Torso falling forward, nearly horizontal, pitching toward the ground away from viewer. Row 2, Cell 5: Entire torso and head making contact with the ground, face down, back of shoulders and head visible. Row 2, Cell 6: Completely still, fully prone lying flat face-down on the ground, back uppermost, head pointing toward upper-right, feet toward lower-left, face completely hidden, harmless theatrical collapse/rest with staff lying diagonally parallel beside the body. Layout & Spacing: Solid pure vivid magenta #FF00FF background with wide empty magenta gutters between cells. Each figure is drawn small inside its cell, occupying only the middle 60% of the cell with at least 15% clear magenta margin on every side. No panel borders, no grid lines, no text, no numbers, no floor plane, no ground shadows, no background scene. Consistent anatomical scale across all 6 poses.
